# The Linux Profiles this job proves against `ubuntu-latest`. One name per line.
#
# This file, not the workflow's matrix, is what the conformance job checks
# itself against: it refuses to report success unless every Profile named here
# produced a fingerprint in that run. A Profile leg that was dropped from the
# matrix, cancelled, or left queued because no Worker was serving it therefore
# fails the job instead of quietly reducing it to a comparison of
# `ubuntu-latest` against itself.
#
# Adding a Profile here without adding a matrix leg for it in
# .github/workflows/conformance.yml turns the job red, which is the intended
# order: declare what must be proven, then go and prove it.
